strings.eq_help_0_body: AutoEQ measures how far your headphone's frequency response deviates from a target curve and builds a stack of correction filters that pull it onto the target. Pick your headphone from the database (or import a measurement) and the filters are computed for you.
strings.eq_help_1_body: Blue is your headphone as measured; the dashed line is the target; the red filled curve is the corrected result — what you should hear. The shaded region between measurement and target is the error the correction mirrors. The axis is relative: 0 dB means "unchanged", +5 means five decibels louder than neutral. Tap a label in the legend to hide or show that curve.
strings.eq_help_2_body: Each numbered dot is one filter, sitting on the corrected curve at its centre frequency. Green boosts, red cuts, grey is near-flat. Drag a dot to move its frequency and gain — a readout shows Hz, dB and Q while you drag. The numbers match the band list further down, where each band also has PEAK / LOW-S / HIGH-S type buttons.
strings.eq_help_3_body: Real units rarely measure identically left and right. Switch on 2-channel calibration to give each ear its own measurement and its own correction. squig.link sources publish true L/R files, so selecting one measurement fills both ears in a single tap; the L|R chips above the graph choose which ear you're editing, and the other ear stays visible as a thin amber curve. Switching the toggle off is non-destructive — the right ear comes back when you re-enable it.
strings.eq_help_4_body: "Import EQ profile" accepts EqualizerAPO / AutoEq ParametricEQ.txt files or pasted text — including profiles copied from chats or web pages with mangled line breaks. You get a preview of the curve, the filter count and any warnings before anything is saved or applied. In 2-channel mode a profile can target both ears or just one.
strings.eq_help_5_body: Boosting frequencies eats headroom: without compensation the loudest peaks would clip. The preamp under the graph pulls overall level down to make room. Leave "Automatic preamp" on and it tracks the real summed peak of your filters (including the tone shelves) so clipping can't happen; switch it off to set the trade-off yourself.
strings.eq_help_6_body: The target menu switches the goal curve (Harman is the safe default; custom targets can be imported). Save the current state as a preset to switch between headphones quickly — presets saved in 2-channel mode keep both ears. Export writes an EqualizerAPO-compatible ParametricEQ.txt you can use anywhere.

strings.oxford_help_0_body: The Inflator shapes the waveform with low-order harmonic distortion driven by the CURVE knob. Unlike a limiter, it doesn't just cap peaks — it adds perceived loudness, density, and warmth or brightness depending on the curve's sign. Keep EFFECT IN lit to hear the processing.
strings.oxford_help_10_body: How fast the compressor clamps down once the signal crosses threshold. Fast (0.1–5 ms) catches transients — kills punch if over-used. Slow (20–50 ms) lets transients through for more snap.
strings.oxford_help_11_body: How fast the gain recovers after the signal drops back below threshold. Short releases (10–80 ms) pump and breathe with the music — great for drums. Long releases (200 ms+) are smoother, better for vocals and master buses.
strings.oxford_help_12_body: Output gain applied after compression so the processed signal matches the bypass level. Bump it up by roughly the amount of reduction shown on the GR meter.
strings.oxford_help_13_body: Gain Reduction display — tells you how many dB the compressor is currently pulling down. If it's pinned, your threshold is too low or ratio too high. If it never moves, threshold is too high.
strings.oxford_help_14_body: VOCAL preset for leads, DRUM BUS to tighten drums, GLUE on your stereo mix bus, LIMITER only on the final master-chain output.
strings.oxford_help_1_body: INPUT drives the signal into the shaping stage (harder drive = more effect). OUTPUT trims the result back to unity. On mixes, nudge INPUT up and OUTPUT down to taste — they're independent, not linked.
strings.oxford_help_2_body: How much of the shaped signal is blended in (0–100 %). Below ~30 % you're in parallel territory; above 60 % the effect becomes obvious. If in doubt, sweep EFFECT while A/B-ing the EFFECT IN button.
strings.oxford_help_3_body: Negative values (-50…0) push even-order harmonics — warmer, analogue-ish. Positive values (0…+50) emphasise odd-order — sharper, more present. Zero is neutral and the mildest setting.
strings.oxford_help_4_body: Hard ceiling at 0 dBFS applied on the way out. Leave on for safety when mastering; turn off if you're feeding another plugin that has its own ceiling management.
strings.oxford_help_5_body: Splits the signal into low / mid / high bands and processes each independently before recombining. Produces tighter results on full mixes and drum buses. More CPU — but worth it on masters.
strings.oxford_help_6_body: Try the WARMTH preset on a vocal or bass, PUNCH on a drum bus, and LOUD on a finished stereo mix. Once you hear what the curve does, you'll reach for it often.
strings.oxford_help_7_body: A compressor reduces gain whenever the signal exceeds a threshold — quieter parts pass through untouched, louder parts get pushed down. Use it to even out performances, add punch, or glue a mix together. EFFECT IN lights up when the compressor is active.
strings.oxford_help_8_body: The level above which compression engages. Lower threshold = more of the signal is compressed. Watch the GR meter — for musical results aim for 2–6 dB reduction on peaks.
strings.oxford_help_9_body: How aggressively signal above threshold is reduced. 2:1 is gentle, 4:1 is classic, 8:1+ is heavy-handed. Ratios above 10:1 start to behave like a limiter.
strings.permission_denied: Access was denied. Enable the music & audio permission in app settings to continue.
strings.permission_files_stay: Your files stay on your device — the permission is only used to read audio files and cover art.
strings.permission_granted: Access granted. Your files stay on your device — nothing is uploaded.
strings.permission_rationale_short: Without this permission Tryptify can’t see any of your music. It’s only used to read audio files and cover art.
strings.permissions_subtitle: Tryptify needs access to your audio files to build your library.
strings.pitch_vocoder_error: Within %1$s. Lower settings are lighter work and less likely to stutter.
strings.playlist_file_unreadable: That file could not be read as a playlist export.
strings.playlists_empty: Create a playlist to organize your music.
strings.preset_flagged_crashes: Crashes the visualizer, so it never loads
strings.presets_no_match: No presets match “%1$s”. Search looks at names across all %2$d.
strings.qobuz_service_detail: Lossless & hi-res streaming through your TrypT HiFi instance. Add it under Settings → Connections → APIs — this finishes onboarding and takes you there.
strings.queue_empty:
Queue is empty.
Play some music to get started.
strings.queue_reset_body: This will remove all upcoming tracks from the queue. The current track will keep playing.
strings.radio_settings_artist_similarity_desc: Keep artist relationships close to the seed.
strings.radio_settings_canonical_bias_desc: Prefer original recordings over remasters, live takes and edits.
strings.radio_settings_discovery_distance_desc: How far recommendations may drift from the seed.
strings.radio_settings_discovery_expansion_desc: How much search/discovery widens the pool.
strings.radio_settings_neutral: 1.00x is neutral. Lower values down-rank a signal, higher values strengthen it. Every one of them is scored on-device.
strings.search_genres_hint: Search 771 genres — try dnb, liquid, phonk
strings.search_unreachable: Couldn’t reach search. Check your connection and try again.
strings.settings_a_moving_spectrum_beside_the_ar: A moving spectrum beside the artwork, matched to the genre's rhythm and the cover's colour. Off leaves the card still.
strings.settings_a_track_at_a_different_sample_r: A track at a different sample rate starts after a brief gap instead of being resampled to match, keeping output bit-perfect. Turn off to keep every transition seamless and let the system resample.
strings.settings_accent_only_the_background_stay: Accent only. The background stays the color your theme chose
strings.settings_album_art_needs_an_application_: Album art needs an application ID. A presence set this way can only show an image Discord itself hosts, and an application is what turns a cover URL into one. Without it you still get the track, artist, album and progress bar.
strings.settings_apply_your_autoeq_tone_to_all_d: Apply your AutoEQ + tone to all device audio (device-permitting)
strings.settings_behind_the_player_and_the_mixer: Behind the player and the mixer: the album art stretched and heavily blurred
strings.settings_blend_desc: The outgoing track fades out while the next fades in over %1$d s.
strings.settings_blend_zero_desc: At zero, tracks run straight into each other with no gap. Add time to overlap them instead.
strings.settings_bloom_the_bass_reactive_glow_ar: Bloom the bass-reactive glow around the album cover too, pumping with the kick.
strings.settings_channel_map_coefficient_downmix: Channel map, coefficient downmix & optional SOFA binaural render
strings.settings_connect_spotify_on_the_connecti: Connect Spotify on the Connections tab to enable URL import
strings.settings_connect_your_spotify_account_to: Connect your Spotify account to import playlists from Library. Note: only Spotify accounts allowlisted for this app can connect while it is in Development mode.
strings.settings_debug_recording_active: Recording… native resolution/fps, stereo media audio. Tap to stop.
strings.settings_debug_recording_idle: Native resolution & fps, stereo internal audio (no mic) → Movies/Tryptify.
strings.settings_discord_has_no_presence_api_for: Discord has no presence API for phones, so the only way to do this is to connect as you. That is against Discord's terms, and while presence-only use has gone unpunished for years, the risk of losing the account is yours.
strings.settings_discord_not_set: Not set. Needed to show what you're playing
strings.settings_discord_on_showing: On. Your profile is showing the current track
strings.settings_discord_set_no_art: Set. Album art off (no application ID)
strings.settings_display_live_audio_spectrum_on_: Display live audio spectrum on the player and the parametric EQ screen
strings.settings_downmix_off: Off. Multichannel passes to the device untouched; DSP/EQ bypassed for those tracks.
strings.settings_downmix_on: Multichannel tracks fold into stereo (fixed matrix) and run through DSP/EQ.
strings.settings_draw_audio_waveforms_between_to: Draw audio waveforms between touch points on the visualizer
strings.settings_exclusive_error: Bypass couldn't engage. See logcat tagged 'LibusbUacDriver' for details.
strings.settings_exclusive_error_desktop: Bypass couldn’t engage. Check that the DAC is bound to WinUSB with Zadig; the debug log has the details.
strings.settings_exclusive_no_device: On, waiting for a USB DAC to be plugged in.
strings.settings_exclusive_off: Off. UAPP-style libusb output. Needs Developer options → Disable USB audio routing → ON, otherwise Android's audio HAL will keep grabbing the DAC and fight us for it.
strings.settings_exclusive_off_winusb: Off. Drives a USB DAC directly through libusb, bypassing Windows audio. On Windows the DAC must first be bound to the WinUSB driver with Zadig, or libusb cannot claim it. WASAPI exclusive, above, is the simpler bit-perfect path.
strings.settings_exclusive_open: DAC handle acquired ✓. Bypass engages on the next track (or skip the current track to engage now).
strings.settings_exclusive_open_desktop: DAC claimed ✓. The bypass starts as soon as something plays.
strings.settings_exclusive_permission: DAC detected. Accept the system USB-permission prompt.
strings.settings_exclusive_streaming: Bit-perfect: bypassing Android audio ✓ (EQ / DSP still active)
strings.settings_exclusive_streaming_desktop: Bit-perfect: bypassing Windows audio ✓ (EQ / DSP still active)
strings.settings_exclusive_winusb_needed: DAC found, but Windows audio still holds it. Bind its audio interfaces to WinUSB with Zadig so libusb can claim it.
strings.settings_export_or_import_your_library_a: Export or import your library and history as a JSON file
strings.settings_fill_screen_in_now_playing_visu: Fill screen in Now Playing visualizer view
strings.settings_flat_opaque_surfaces_instead_of: Flat, opaque surfaces instead of blurred, refractive glass throughout the app.
strings.settings_follow_the_size_set_in_android_: Follow the size set in Android Settings › Display › Font size
strings.settings_genre_charts_don_t_need_this_th: Genre charts don't need this. They read public data with a key built into the app. Entering one here makes charts use yours instead.
strings.settings_hides_the_notification_bar_and_: Hides the notification bar and the bottom gesture bar everywhere in the app. Swipe in from an edge to bring them back for a moment.
strings.settings_hires_off: Off. Hi-res files are cut to 16-bit before the DSP on Bluetooth and the speaker.
strings.settings_hires_on: On. 24-bit and float files keep full resolution through the DSP to Android's output, so LDAC/aptX HD get 24-bit. Changing speed falls back to 16-bit.
strings.settings_holds_the_visualizer_back_to_ma: Holds the visualizer back to match what you hear. Raise it on Bluetooth, where the headphones add their own delay; leave it at zero on speaker or wired.
strings.settings_home_library_and_search_are_alw: Home, Library and Search are always there. Pick up to two pages for the middle.
strings.settings_how_far_the_halo_reaches_past_t: How far the halo reaches past the cover's edge
strings.settings_how_long_the_album_s_colours_ta: How long the album's colours take to cross over when the track changes. Longer means more of the screen repainting for longer.
strings.settings_idle_play_a_track_to_detect_its: Idle. Play a track to detect its channel layout.
strings.settings_karaoke_timing_source_when_your: Karaoke-timing source when your instance has no synced lyrics. Both = each falls back to the other.
strings.settings_keep_a_copy_of_every_song_you_l: Keep a copy of every song you like from now on. Songs you liked earlier are left alone. Turning this on never starts a bulk download.
strings.settings_keep_original_pitch_when_changi: Keep original pitch when changing speed
strings.settings_lastfm_callback: Set the application's Callback URL to %1$s so authorising returns to Tryptify.
strings.settings_lastfm_click_to_authorise: Not connected. Click to authorise in your browser
strings.settings_lastfm_key_needed: Needed to scrobble. Scrobbles are signed with your own secret and posted to your own listening history, so they use your credentials rather than a key shared by everyone. Create a pair free at last.fm/api/account/create.
strings.settings_lastfm_key_set: Set. Scrobbling can sign as you
strings.settings_lastfm_not_set: Not set. Needed for scrobbling and for all-time charts
strings.settings_lastfm_not_set_charts: Not set. Charts use the built-in key; scrobbling needs yours
strings.settings_lastfm_secret_missing: Key set, secret missing. Scrobbling still can't sign
strings.settings_lastfm_tap_to_authorise: Not connected. Tap to authorise in your browser
strings.settings_let_the_cover_set_the_app_s_acc: Let the cover set the app's accent and background everywhere, not just the player
strings.settings_let_the_visualizer_exceed_displ: Let the visualizer exceed display refresh (capped by Target FPS). Increases battery and heat. Adreno honours this; some GPUs ignore it.
strings.settings_live_logcat_stream_for_this_pro: Live logcat stream for this process. Copy or export as a file for bug reports
strings.settings_look_on_github_for_a_newer_rele: Look on GitHub for a newer release now
strings.settings_mini_player_hide_with_tabs: Hide mini player when the nav bar shows
strings.settings_mini_player_hide_with_tabs_desc: Scroll up for the nav bar, down for the mini player. Tap the page you’re on in the nav bar to bring the player back.
Scroll up for the nav bar, down for the mini player. Click the page you’re on in the nav bar to bring the player back.
strings.settings_no_app_for_link: No app found to open the link
strings.settings_no_transitions_bounces_glass_mo: No transitions, bounces, glass motion or colour blends anywhere in the app.
strings.settings_output_device_missing: The chosen device isn’t connected. Playing on the system default until it’s back.
strings.settings_output_exclusive_buffer_desc: Longer guards against dropouts; shorter makes seeking and volume changes respond sooner. Changing it reopens the device.
strings.settings_output_mode_exclusive_desc: Tryptify takes the device for itself: other apps go silent while it plays, and the stream reaches the DAC at its own sample rate and bit depth, untouched by the Windows mixer.
strings.settings_output_mode_java_sound_desc: The fallback for when the WASAPI library is missing. Plays through the system mixer.
strings.settings_output_mode_shared_desc: Through the Windows mixer, alongside other apps. Windows converts the stream to the device’s mix format.
strings.settings_output_usb_override: The USB DAC is carrying the audio through libusb (Exclusive USB DAC, below). This output takes over for anything the DAC refuses, and once it is unplugged.
strings.settings_overlay_the_spectrum_on_the_alb: Overlay the spectrum on the album-art hero
strings.settings_peak_strength_of_the_halo_on_a_: Peak strength of the halo on a kick
strings.settings_pick_your_own_accent_and_backgr: Pick your own accent and background. Overrides the theme above
strings.settings_preview_the_quick_brown_fox_jum: Preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
strings.settings_rotation_off_desc: Nothing changes the preset. Picking one, and Next, still work.
strings.settings_rotation_timer_desc: A new preset every so often, for as long as the visualizer is up.
strings.settings_rotation_track_desc: A new preset when the track changes, and nothing in between.
strings.settings_run_the_first_time_setup_again_: Run the first-time setup again. Your library and settings are kept.
strings.settings_sign_in_to_sync_favorites_and_p: Sign in to sync favorites and playlists across devices.
strings.settings_smaller_lower_latency_more_cpu_: Smaller = lower latency, more CPU. Default 1024.
strings.settings_spectrum_circle: Off. The spectrum sits in the small circle
strings.settings_swaps_the_app_s_exact_correctio: Swaps the app's exact correction for a coarser global one, and some devices ignore it entirely. Turn it on to correct other apps.
strings.settings_target_fps_free: Caps the visualizer while it is free-running.
strings.settings_target_fps_vsync: Applies with vsync off. While the visualizer is display-synced the panel sets the rate and this is not used.
strings.settings_the_ground_every_light_theme_is: The ground every light theme is printed on. Crisp is true white; warm is off-white, for less glare.
strings.settings_the_order_of_the_switcher_at_th: The order of the switcher at the top of Library. Gray out the ones you don't use and they leave it.
strings.settings_this_is_your_discord_account_to: This is your Discord account token, not a password and not an app password. Anything holding it can read your messages and act as you. Tryptify keeps it on this device only and never syncs it, but paste it only if that trade is one you want to make.
strings.settings_this_resets_all_app_settings_an: This resets all app settings and clears cached data. Your saved library, playlists, favorites, and downloads are kept.
strings.settings_tint_the_player_from_album_art_: Tint the player from album art (needs Dynamic Colors on); off keeps the player on the theme color
strings.settings_tint_the_player_mini_player_and: Tint the player, mini player and lyrics from album art. The menus keep the theme color. Off, everything uses the theme color
strings.settings_titles_from_file_names_desc: Name local songs after their files instead of their title tags. Changing this rescans the library.
strings.settings_transliterate_japanese_lyrics_t: Transliterate Japanese lyrics to Latin characters
strings.settings_tryptify_is_built_and_maintaine: Tryptify is built and maintained by trypt. If it's earned a place in your day, a tip keeps the lights on and the next features shipping.
strings.settings_turns_off_animations_the_liquid: Turns off animations, the liquid glass effect and the new player design in one go. Saves battery and helps on older or slower devices.
strings.settings_usb_on_waiting: On. Plug in a USB DAC to start routing.
strings.settings_use_a_channel_you_don_t_mind_fi: Use a channel you don't mind filling up. A private server of your own is the usual answer. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the channel and Copy Channel ID. Leave it empty to keep the plain cover and the circle.
strings.settings_use_the_account_page_to_sign_in: Use the Account page to sign in with Google or email.
strings.settings_use_the_flat_player_design_from: Use the flat player design from before liquid glass.
strings.settings_use_the_native_opengl_renderer_: Use the native OpenGL renderer when the bridge is available
strings.settings_with_a_channel_set_the_spectrum: With a channel set, the spectrum is drawn across the album art itself instead of in the small circle. That means an image per track, and Discord only shows images it can fetch, so each one is posted here as an attachment and the card points at it.
strings.settings_you_ll_stop_syncing_favorites_a: You'll stop syncing favorites and playlists across devices until you sign back in.
strings.shelf_gone: That shelf isn’t in the current feed any more.
strings.shelf_next_on_map: Next to it on the map
strings.shelf_ranked_by_plays_and_artists: ranked by plays and its most-played artists
strings.sign_in_benefit: Sync your favorites and playlists across devices
strings.speaker_angle_note: Narrow angles give the strongest crossfeed. At 180° the speakers sit at your ears and no crossfeed is applied.
strings.spotify_connected_as: Connected as %1$s — radio & recommendations, resolved to tracks you own.
strings.spotify_connected_plain: Connected — radio & recommendations, resolved to tracks you own.
strings.spotify_service_detail: Radio & recommendations, resolved to your local and Qobuz tracks.
strings.spotify_strict_detail: Album name must match Spotify metadata
strings.station_directory_unreachable_detail: Couldn’t reach the station directory. It’s the listing that’s missing, not the radio — try again in a moment.
strings.stats_sign_in_to_sync: Sign in to sync stats across devices
strings.streaming_subtitle: Optional — connect services now or any time in Settings.
strings.strict_album_matching_detail: Only accept a match from the same album. Off finds more, but sometimes the wrong recording.
strings.system_wide_caution: Swaps the app's exact correction for a coarser global one. For correcting other apps.
strings.tidal_offer_body: “%1$s” by %2$s isn’t available from TIDAL right now. Qobuz has the same recording. Play it from Qobuz?
strings.tidal_service_detail: Hi-res & lossless catalog through your TrypT HiFi instance — the default source, ready once your instance is connected.
strings.timeline_caption: Oldest left, newest right — each subgenre branches under its parent
strings.tour_dsp_text: Oxford-style Inflator and Compressor, right in the signal chain.
strings.tour_hires_text: Bit-perfect playback all the way up to your DAC’s limits.
strings.tour_radio_text: Spotify recommendations, resolved to tracks you actually own.
strings.tour_sound_text: Parametric EQ with AutoEQ profiles for hundreds of headphones.
strings.update_available_detail: Tap to see the release on GitHub
strings.waterfall_angle_depth_pinch_weight_drag_: ↕ angle · ↔ depth · pinch weight · drag the fade line
strings.waterfall_avg_time_unused: The averaging time does not apply to the long-term types.
strings.waterfall_colour_desc: The album’s colour follows the cover; a custom one stays the same on every track. Heat keeps its own palette.
strings.waterfall_demo: Demo signal: play something to see your music
strings.waterfall_how_far_back_a_line_stays_at_f: How far back a line stays at full strength before fading
strings.waterfall_how_long_a_line_takes_to_trave: How long a line takes to travel back and disappear
strings.waterfall_how_often_the_waterfall_is_dra: How often the waterfall is drawn. Lower saves GPU and battery; Max is every refresh the display gives.
strings.waterfall_knobs_hint: Overlap: how much each analysis overlaps the last. Higher moves more smoothly; lower steps, and saves a little battery. Drag a knob up or down; double-tap it to reset.
strings.waterfall_knobs_hint_desktop: Overlap: how much each analysis overlaps the last. Higher moves more smoothly; lower steps, and saves a little battery. Drag a knob up or down, scroll over it or use the arrow keys; double-click it or press Delete to reset.
strings.waterfall_low_a_near_flat_horizon_high_l: Low: a near-flat horizon. High: looking down on the ridges
strings.waterfall_preview_hint_desktop: ↕ angle · ↔ depth · Ctrl+scroll weight · drag the fade line
strings.waterfall_preview_paused_while_the_other: Preview paused while the other one is on screen
strings.waterfall_style_glass_desc: One line: the live spectrum as a pool of liquid glass that morphs with the music and refracts the cover
strings.waterfall_style_heat_desc: Coloured by height: green at the floor, yellow-white at the peaks
strings.waterfall_style_legacy_desc: One line: the original spectrum, a flowing envelope filled down to the baseline
strings.waterfall_style_lines_desc: See-through lines in the album colour, lightening at the peaks
strings.waterfall_style_neon_desc: Lines add up where they cross, so dense areas glow
strings.waterfall_style_ridgeline_desc: Each line hides what is behind it, like a mountain range
strings.waterfall_summary: %1$s, %2$.1f dp, %3$s. %4$d lines, one every %5$d ms. Full strength for %6$.1f s, then fading over %7$.1f s; gone %8$.1f s after it was heard. Rising at %9$d°.
strings.waterfall_the_spectrum_on_the_album_art_: The spectrum on the album art. The bright line at the front is now; every moment a copy of it falls back, rises and fades, so the last few seconds stand behind it.
strings.waterfall_thick_bands_or_fine_hairlines_: Thick bands, or fine hairlines like a radio sweep
strings.waterfall_type_avg_desc: The average since the track started: its long-term tonal balance. Starts over on each track.
strings.waterfall_type_max_desc: The loudest each bar has been since the track started. Starts over on each track.
strings.waterfall_type_rt_avg_desc: Each bar rises quickly and falls back over the averaging time.
strings.waterfall_type_rt_max_desc: Each bar jumps to a peak, holds it for the hold time, then falls.
strings.waterfall_vsync_off: Hold the exact frame rate by the clock: the number you picked, spaced slightly unevenly
strings.waterfall_vsync_on: Snap the frame rate to an even step of the display's refresh: smooth, evenly spaced frames
strings.wavecandy_draw_the_waveform_in_the_album: Draw the waveform in the album's accent instead of white
strings.wavecandy_stereo_on: Left across the top, right across the bottom
strings.wavecandy_the_cover_punches_in_on_each_k: The cover punches in on each kick drum
strings.wavecandy_the_oscilloscope_on_the_album_: The oscilloscope on the album art, and the cover punching in on the kick. Switch to it with the waveform button on the art.
strings.welcome_tagline: Bit-perfect, high-res playback — your library, your way.
